title: CloudGoat: cloud breach S3
description: A CloudGoat scenario by Rhino Security Labs, deployed into your own AWS account: as an anonymous outsider, abuse a misconfigured reverse proxy to query the EC2 metadata service, take the instance profile's keys, then find and exfiltrate the cardholder data in a private S3 bucket.
question: From the reverse proxy alone, retrieve the cardholder data stored in the private S3 bucket.
